rows.grounds: compound describing the nectar as the true essence of Kaula
imperative command addressed to the listener
compound qualifying the nectar as consisting of kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: A nectar is presented as the object to be heard.
This nectar is identified as the true nature of Kaula.
This nectar is characterized as having the nature of kāmakalā.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is the true essence of Kaula, whose nature is kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, whose nature is kāmakalā.
